notes.text: Low-lying drains need desilting; EFB applied at 50 t/ha (Agro: only 10% of planned EFB done by June).
No leaf sampling: palms over 25 years old and due for replanting within five years.

blocks.fert: 2027 programme (Agro 2/2026): Mix A 2000 g x4 + RP 1500 g per palm

notes.text: Jan-Jun yield 9.88 t/ha vs 10.79 in 2025 (-8.43%), the best field this year.
Vigour and bunch formation improved in B2-B5 after soil mounding; B6 (mounding discontinued) shows uneven canopy and unopened spears.
New Ganoderma census under way; highest fallen-palm count (9,894).

blocks.fert: 2027 programme (Agro 2/2026): C1-C4 NK1 2000 g x2 + RP 1500 g + Mix A 2000 g x2; C5-C6 NK1 2250 g x2 + RP 1500 g + Mix B 2000 g x2

notes.text: Jan-Jun yield 7.88 t/ha vs 12.30 in 2025 (-35.9%), the steepest fall.
Delayed harvesting in several blocks led to overripe bunches; mild K deficiency in C3/C4; marginally low leaf P in C4/C5.
Budgeted Ganoderma deboling and mounding not yet started; drains need desilting.

blocks.fert: 2027 programme (Agro 2/2026): Mix B 2250 g x2 + RP 1500 g + Mix A 2000 g x2

notes.text: Leaf P marginally low in all sub-blocks; mild K deficiency in D2/D3 low-lying areas; EFB 42% of plan done.

summary: Yield to June is 8.82 t/ha, 23% below the same period of 2025 (11.50); every field is down, P05C worst at -35.9% (Agro 2/2026).
Jan–May FFB 7,078.90 mt (7.26 t/ha) against an estimate of 9,867 mt (10.12 t/ha); cost of production RM292.76/t vs RM286.61 budget, mainly from head office/agency fees (PA 1/2026).
Manuring only 52% done: Mixture A and Mixture B not yet applied because of late delivery and too few manurers (4 of 8).
Ganoderma is the main yield limiter: 190.70 ha already vacant, 2,189 infected and 21,048 fallen palms; P05C deboling/mounding not started.
Harvester output is only 1.23–1.28 t/day with earnings below minimum wage; target is 2.00 t/day.

issues.title: FFB budget shortfall stated inconsistently
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 para 9.1 says Jan–May FFB 7,078.90 mt is a 10% deficit against a budget of 8,664.77 mt, but 7,078.90 is 18.3% below 8,664.77, and Table 19 gives an estimate of 9,867.00 mt (10.12 t/ha), which is 28% above actual.

issues.title: Harvesting rounds contradict across reports
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 summary says 21.89 rounds against a minimum 22.00; PA para 7.3 says 10.58 rounds in 5 months; Agro 2/2026 Table 14 says 12.81 rounds to June (106.75% of target).

issues.title: Harvest interval differs
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 reports 11–14 days for Jan–May; Agro 2/2026 Table 6 shows 14–16 days in Jan–Mar and up to 16 days, improving to 10–14 days in Apr–Jun.

issues.title: 2025 same-period yield does not reconcile
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 Table 13 gives Jan–Jun 2025 yield 11.50 t/ha on 974.82 ha, but its own Appendix 3 shows 1H 2025 production of 10,595.53 mt, i.e. 10.87 t/ha on 974.82 ha. The 2025 base may use a different area or crop figure.

issues.title: Palm density (SPH) differs
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Table 2 gives SPH 118/109/110/128 (avg 115); Agro 2/2026 Table 3 gives 136/136/136/148 (avg 139) for the same 974.82 ha, and the Agro Ganoderma table repeats 118/109/110/127 (avg 116). Agro itself says the SPH method must be reviewed.

issues.title: Harvester productivity figure inconsistent
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 para 7.4 and 12.10 say 1.28 t/day; Table 17 total shows 1.23 t/day; the table's own total 7,078.90 mt / 5,455 mandays = 1.30 t/day.

issues.title: Typos in PA cost text vs tables
issues.detail: PA 1/2026: pest & disease budget is RM88.79/ha in Table 7 but RM68.79 in para 6.3.7 (RM67,060/974.82 ha = RM68.79, so the table is wrong); manuring RM476.98/ha in table vs RM475.96 in para 6.2.4; weeding budget RM86.02 in table vs RM86.12 in para 6.1.10, which also calls it 6% over when it is 1%; COP budget RM286.61 in Table 20 vs RM286.76 in para 10.1; selective sprayer earnings RM85.50 in table vs RM82.50 in para 6.1.8.

issues.title: General charges appendix errors
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Appendix 2: head office/agency fees budget to date shows RM20,000 but the supervision subtotal (RM351,136) only adds up if it is RM120,000; 'Other' cost/ha 178.41 in Table 6 vs 174.81 in Appendix (RM170,408.35/974.82 = 174.81); total cost/ha 715.42 in Table 6 vs 711.82 in Appendix; labour 'cost/ha' annual shown as 649,830.00.

issues.title: P06D FFB differs between PA tables
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Table 19 shows P06D FFB 1,780.26 mt, Table 17 shows 1,780.20 mt; neither set sums exactly to the stated 7,078.90 mt (7,078.88 and 7,078.82).

issues.title: Barn owl box condition differs
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 says 48 of 153 barn owl boxes are damaged; Agro 2/2026 Table 10 shows 56 in poor condition (97 good).

actions.item: Apply outstanding Mixture A and Mixture B immediately; mobilise more manurers
Start budgeted Ganoderma deboling and mounding in P05C
Carry out new Ganoderma census (five categories) and update palm census/SPH
Start road grading (2,500 chains budgeted, none done)
Desilt drains in low-lying P99A and P05C (about 150 ha)
Raise harvester productivity towards 2.00 t/day and verify earnings records
Secure enough harvesters for the 2H peak to keep intervals under 15 days
Repair or replace barn owl boxes in poor condition
Conduct proper area survey to confirm planted area
Adopt low-volume spraying (Inter Pump/CDA) and semi-mechanised manuring (Timac)
Spray boundary and repair trenches with neighbouring estates
Record running costs of manager's Hilux

kb:
LADANG PROSPER KEMAYAN - FACT PACK (Prosper Capital Holdings Sdn Bhd)
Sources: PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisor En. Mohd Sufian Bin Yusoff, visit 25 June 2026, review period Jan-May 2026, accounts to April 2026) and Agronomy Report 2/2026 (visit 16 July 2026 by Junior Agronomist En. Muhammad Nurhafizi Zahari with Senior Agronomist Mr. Chong Kuan Ming; sets the 2027 manuring programme). Plantation Controller Dr. Chua Chin Kok; Senior Manager En. Mat Zin Bin Mat Akir; Assistant In-Charge En. Mohd Zulkifly Bin Ismail; Assistant Manager Nur Syafiq Syazzany.

AREA (PA 1/2026, as of 31 May 2026): Total 1,170.73 ha. Mature oil palm 974.82 ha (83%), vacant Ganoderma-infested land 190.70 ha (16%), unplantable 5.21 ha. No immature or replant area; no replanting in 2026. Fields: P99A 182.26 ha (1999, SPH 118), P04B 310.31 ha (2004, SPH 109), P05C 234.68 ha (2005, SPH 110), P06D 247.57 ha (2006, SPH 128); average SPH 115. All palms over 20 years old. Estate proposed replanting from 2027 (under consideration). Agro 2/2026: planted area cut from 1,165.52 to 974.82 ha by excluding Ganoderma vacant areas; recommends proper area survey; replanting programme for 2027/2028 should be finalised. Agro Table 3 shows SPH of 136/136/136/148 (avg 139) on current area, but says this SPH, which excludes vacant points and dead palms, is inappropriate and must be reviewed. Terrain flat to undulating; average rainfall about 2,000 mm and 135 rain days over 5 years (PA).

LABOUR AND STAFF (PA 1/2026, 31 May 2026): 67 workers (5 estate checkroll, 62 contractor) vs requirement 72 (short 5), ratio 1 worker:15 ha. Harvesters 46 vs 48 required (1:21 ha); drivers/loaders 6/6; weeding 6/10; manuring 4/8; watchmen 3; general 2. 5 recruited and 2 absconded in 4 months. Five contractors (Desmond Agro, Chua Chee Tiong, Zian-Zian Plantation, Malaiqa Bina, Suhanizan Bin Ishak) each 100-300 ha; PA says minimum economic size is 400 ha per contractor and suggests a contractor evaluation. Machinery: 10 mechanical buffaloes (3 Timac, 6 Agrostar, 1 TF) plus 1 mini tractor. PA 8.3: 5-year yield potential about 22,500 mt implies ideal 42 harvesters and 9 machines (2.00 t/day per harvester, 10 t/day per machine). Staff adequate; junior assistant Loh Wen Min moved to audit. Agro 2/2026 says insufficient manuring manpower is delaying the programme and harvesting manpower must be secured for the 2H peak.

CROP (PA 1/2026): Jan-May 2026 FFB 7,078.90 mt = 7.26 t/ha. PA text says this is a 10% deficit against a budget of 8,664.77 mt, but Table 19 gives an estimate of 9,867.00 mt (10.12 t/ha). Field yields Jan-May (actual vs estimate t/ha): P99A 7.06 vs 9.56; P04B 8.09 vs 9.99; P05C 6.40 vs 10.42; P06D 7.19 vs 10.43. May 2026 column: 7.98, 8.54, 9.53, 9.38, total 8.89. Agro 2/2026 (as at June): 8.82 t/ha vs 11.50 same period 2025 (-23.3%); P99A 8.30 vs 10.52 (-21.1%), P04B 9.88 vs 10.79 (-8.43%), P05C 7.88 vs 12.30 (-35.9%), P06D 8.75 vs 12.33 (-29.0%). Agro attributes declines to seasonal trend and the May-June dry spell; expects improvement in 2H. Monthly production (Agro Appendix 3), mt: 2026 Jan 1,496.46, Feb 1,110.66, Mar 1,447.66, Apr 1,668.28, May 1,355.84, Jun 1,515.92 (1H 8,594.82). 1H totals: 2022 10,387.22; 2023 11,533.73; 2024 12,310.15; 2025 10,595.53. Full-year totals: 2022 22,373.29; 2023 21,148.53; 2024 23,581.34; 2025 21,698.93 mt. PA 2.2 says FFB has stayed above 18.00 t/ha a year for 5 years.

HARVESTING (PA 1/2026): interval 11-14 days over 5 months, 10.58 rounds (summary page says 21.89 rounds vs minimum 22.00). Harvester productivity to date 1.28 t/day (table total 1.23) covering 2.22 ha/day, well below the 2.00 t target and 2.50-3.50 t aim with mechanised collection. Field productivity (t/manday, rate RM/t, earnings RM/day): P99A 1.37, 40.00, 54.80; P04B 1.15, 35.00, 40.25; P05C 1.23, 35.00, 43.05; P06D 1.47, 35.00, 51.45. Earnings below minimum wage; estate to verify data. Ripe crop above 90%; occasional overripe in wet low-lying areas. Agro 2/2026 intervals: Jan-Mar 14-16 days, Apr-Jun 10-14 days; cumulative rounds to June 12.81 (106.75% of target: P99A 12.83, P04B 12.88, P05C 12.58, P06D 12.94). Overripe bunches insignificant on random check, though P05C blocks showed delayed harvesting. PA concluding remark: keep intervals under 15 days.

COST (PA 1/2026, to 30 April 2026): Cost of production RM292.76/t vs budget RM286.61/t in Table 20 (text says RM286.76); annual budget RM275.19/t. General charges RM121.25/t vs 100.49 (21% over; supervision, head office and agency fees); upkeep and cultivation RM103.71/t vs 116.91 (11% under, delayed manuring, minimal pest work); harvesting and collection RM67.80/t vs 69.21. Totals RM1,675,502 vs budget RM2,084,232 to date (annual RM6,252,632). General charges RM693,900.85 = RM715.42/ha vs RM749.56/ha budget (5% under; labour recruitment RM23,383.57 vs 110,296 budget, fringe benefits nil). Overspends: head office/agency fees RM200,475.05 (+67%, RM205.65/ha), security RM57,183.43 (+87%, extra night watchman), paid leave RM38,334.10 (+58%), EPF executive/staff +35%, bonus +5%, consultant fees +42%, office +14%. Upkeep RM/ha actual vs budget to date: weeding 87.11 vs 86.02; manuring 476.98 vs 645.79; pest and disease 0.13 vs 88.79 (text says 68.79); census/thinning 2.31 vs 0.57; drains 0.41 vs 3.00; bridges/culverts 0.67 vs 2.77; roads 1.83 vs 24.59; boundaries 1.74 vs 1.04; pruning 37.70 vs 39.55; total 608.88 vs 872.12 (RM593,557 vs RM850,160). Harvesting RM388,044 (harvesting 45.71/t, transport 17.57/t, others 0.42/t, top-up wages 4.10/t). Estate owns only a Toyota Hilux; PA wants its running costs recorded.

MANURING: PA 1/2026 to May: 491.65 mt applied of 955.15 mt 1H programme (52%); received 552.25 mt. AS 121.90 done (Jan); NK1 Feb/Mar done, April 39.40 of 114.45 mt (34%), May/June nil; ARP 164.50 done; Mix B nil (late delivery); Mix A nil. Workers 27-30 bags/day earning RM62.90-69.00. Agro 2/2026 to June: 547.40 mt of 1,073.45 mt annual (52%): NK1 261.00 of 414.35 (63%), Mix B 0 of 199.00 (0%, only 30 mt received), RP 164.50 (100%), Mix A 0 of 173.70 (0%, none received), AS 121.90 (100%). Agro says Mix A (May-June) must be done immediately; delays must not exceed two months; mobilise more manurers. No manuring during visit due to RSPO audit prep. Store acceptable. 2027 programme (kg/palm): P99A Mix A 2.00 + NK1 2.00 x2; P04B Mix A 2.00 x4 + RP 1.50; P05C C1-C4 NK1 2.00 x2 + RP 1.50 + Mix A 2.00 x2, C5-C6 NK1 2.25 x2 + RP 1.50 + Mix B 2.00 x2; P06D Mix B 2.25 x2 + RP 1.50 + Mix A 2.00 x2. EFB: PA says 4,660 mt applied in P99A and P06D at 50 t/ha; Agro (June) 6,105.48 mt over 122.11 ha: P99A 896.44 mt (10% of area), P06D 5,209.04 mt (42%). Ecofert discontinued since 2025.

LEAF NUTRIENTS (Agro 2/2026, P04B/P05C/P06D sampled): N normal-high; P marginally low in C4, C5 and D1-D5; K normal except B2 marginally low (0.92%); Mg/Ca mostly acceptable, Ca marginally low in all P05C, Mg marginally low in D4/D5; B sufficient. Mild K deficiency symptoms in C3/C4 (sandy) and D2/D3 (low-lying). Overall status acceptable.

FIELD UPKEEP: PA: one round circle spraying done on 974.82 ha (100% of to-date programme, 1 of 3 rounds); selective spraying 1,784.41 ha vs 1,764.71 ha to-date programme (table still on old 1,165.52 ha). Sprayer output 4.0 ha (circle) and 4.5 ha (selective) per day. Recommend low-volume Inter Pump/CDA and keeping circles to 2 m radius. Agro: two rounds interrow done in all fields; circle 2 rounds in P99A/P04B, 1 round in P05C/P06D; Clidemia not fully killed (poor wetting), tighten premix supervision. Pruning: PA 2 rounds 100% done; Agro notes many under-pruned palms despite 100% progress. Drains: about 150 ha low-lying flood-prone; desilt P99A and P05C (PA); Agro saw no waterlogging. Roads: grading budget 2,500 chains, none done; backhoe 132 of 850 h. Boundaries: spray and repair trenches; no encroachment seen.

PESTS AND GANODERMA: Rat damage below 3% (PA); Agro Q1/Q2 2.25-3.50%, under 10% threshold, no baiting. 153 barn owl boxes, 86 occupied (56%); PA says 48 damaged; Agro shows 97 good, 56 poor and says 117 boxes would be optimal (1 per 10 ha), occupancy against that ratio is 73%. Bagworm: 3%/2% in Jan (P05C/P06D) then 0%. Ganoderma: PA says 17% of palms dead or infested; Agro census shows 2,189 infected and 21,048 fallen palms (P99A 808/3,124; P04B 911/9,894; P05C 277/3,612; P06D 193/4,418). Agro: infection increasing; new census in five categories required; mound to 1 m where infection exceeds 5%; deboling now improved to specification. PA: P05C deboling/mounding budgeted but not started.

RAINFALL: 2022 1,685.0 mm/120 days; 2023 1,850.5/123; 2024 2,212.0/149; 2025 2,025.0/151; 2026 Jan-Jun 694.5 mm/57 days (Jan 13, Mar 30 and Jun 65.5 mm were very low; Agro flags water stress).

notes: FFB tonnes not printed for the Jan-Apr cost period; ffb field is implied (RM388,044 harvesting & collection / RM67.80 per t = 5,723.5 t actual; budget todate implied 7,272 t). Report's Jan-May FFB is 7,078.90 t and Table 17 shows 5,455 t, neither used.
Harvest & collection per-tonne items are printed in Table 16 (not calc). Upkeep and General charges items are RM amounts divided by implied FFB (calc:true); the report prints only RM/ha for them.
Table 16 prints annual-budget column Harvesting as 45.71 (same as actual) - looks like a typo; todate budget 47.60 used. Items sum to 67.80 actual and 69.21 budget, matching group totals.
Upkeep items sum to RM593,557 = group total. Total budget printed 286.61 in Table 20 (text 10.1 says 286.76).

General charges has 29 appendix lines; kept 13 largest plus Other. Sub-totals reconcile: Supervision 421,260.83; Labour items sum 102,231.34 vs printed 102,231.67 (RM0.33 diff); Other 170,408.35; printed total 693,900.85 (Table 6) vs 693,901 (Table 20).

Appendix 2 prints Head Office/Agency Fees budget todate as RM20,000 (annual RM360,000); this is a typo - other lines sum to RM610,770 so RM120,000 (annual/3) is needed to reach the printed RM730,772 todate subtotal. RM120,000 used for the budget item (calc).

ffbProd.notes: Area basis changed from 1,165.52 ha to 974.82 ha. PA budget/estimate figures excluded. PA 1/2026 Jan-May 7,078.90 equals the Jan-May sum of monthly figures. Jan 2025 526.31 as printed.
